## BlueActions.getReallocations property

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.

Computes Vault V1 PublicAllocator reallocations using the deprecated unversioned name.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getReallocations: (params: VaultV1ReallocationsParams) => readonly VaultV1Reallocation[];
```

## Remarks

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: The borrow or withdraw amount used to compute post-state utilization.
